::: {#exm-repetition-code-distance}
#### The repetition code corrects one error

The binary repetition code sends each bit three times:
$E(0) = 000$ and $E(1) = 111$.
Its minimum distance is $d = 3$,
so by @thm-distance-corrects-errors it corrects $t = 1$ error:
a received $010$ decodes to $000$, the codeword it is nearest to.
The price is the rate, $R = 1/3$.
@mackay2003information [chapter 1] calls this code $R_3$,
and the
[channel capacity page](channel-capacity.qmd#exm-repetition-code)
finds its error probability on a noisy channel.

:::
